scenarios.title: Embalm exiles the card as a cost and creates a white Zombie token copy with no mana cost
decisions: A activates embalm {W} of Sacred Cat from the graveyard, tapping the Plains and exiling Sacred Cat as part of the cost.
B has priority with the ability on the stack and passes; A passes.

variants.label: resolves
variants.expected: Sacred Cat is in exile, not in the graveyard. A token copy of Sacred Cat is created on the battlefield: a white Zombie Cat, 1/1 with lifelink, with no mana cost.

variants.label: ability_countered
variants.delta: B responds by casting Stifle with the Island, targeting the embalm ability.
variants.expected: The embalm ability is countered. Sacred Cat stays in exile because exiling was a cost, and no token is created. Stifle is in B's graveyard.

scenarios.title: Embalm can be activated only as a sorcery
decisions: A tries to activate embalm {W} of Sacred Cat from the graveyard, tapping the Plains.
Both players pass; if the ability was activated, it resolves.

variants.label: main_phase
variants.expected: Activation is legal with an empty stack during A's main phase. After resolution a white Zombie Cat token copy of Sacred Cat is on the battlefield and the card is in exile.

variants.label: end_step
variants.delta: It is A's end step instead of the first main phase.
variants.expected: Activation is not legal outside a main phase. Sacred Cat stays in A's graveyard and the Plains stays untapped.
